title: Intercepted enemy cipher letters summarised for Nevers, Sept-Oct 1589 (BnF fr. 3977 no. 96)

steps.what: Parsed the BnF depouillement of fr. 3977 (138 pieces) and located no. 96 at fol. 318 = canvas 520.
Read no. 96: a clear French digest in fifteen points; points 1-9 transcribed.
Swept every Sept-Oct 1589 piece in the volume for the ciphered originals.

outcome.method_basis: BnF fr. 3977 no. 96 is the clear-French summary of the Sept-Oct 1589 intercepts; the ciphered letters themselves do not survive in the volume.

credits.note: PR #9: no ciphertext under no. 96 (clear summary); eleven other glossed intercepts found in the volume

prior.where: BnF fr. 3977 no. 96 is the contemporary interpretation itself

human: External contributor (PR #9, Arya Sanketbhai Patel); the profile was written at merge time from targets/nevers1589/NOTES.md.
